features: Analog Turbo HD TVI over coax/BNC — NOT an IP camera, connects to a Turbo HD DVR
ColorVu 3.0 with HikAI-ISP, 24/7 full-color imaging with F1.0 aperture
Smart-Hybrid dual light: IR up to 50m + white light up to 50m
built-in mic + built-in speaker, two-way audio over coax
active strobe (red/blue flashing) light and audible alarm, AI DNR
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE72KV0T-LXTS is an analog Turbo HD 3K (5MP) ColorVu 3.0 Smart-Hybrid dual-light turret with HikAI-ISP, 50m IR and 50m white light, a built-in mic and speaker for two-way audio over coax, and an active strobe/siren deterrent.
